revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 15.1% (478,834 vs 416,161); fade from 8% toward ~4% as the base scales and converges toward terminal growth.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: held at FY2026 actual 33.0% (158,063/478,834), accession 0000320193-26-000026; no further expansion assumed, conservative given services mix.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate = 1 - net income 132,175 / pretax income 159,237 = 17.0%, accession 0000320193-26-000026.

wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM cost of equity = 10Y UST 4.86% (Treasury 2026-11-06) + beta ~1.05 (my assumption, industry beta not fetched) x US ERP 4.46% (Damodaran 2026-02-16) = ~9.5%; debt is ~2% of capital so WACC ~ cost of equity.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the 4.86% risk-free rate and long-run nominal US GDP growth; rationale of a mature-company perpetuity.

net_debt.source: financial_statements AAPL derived net_debt = total debt 80,111 (LT debt noncurrent 68,208 + current 9,906 + commercial paper 1,997) - cash 36,305 - marketable securities 20,417; accession 0000320193-26-000026
